parameters.jsCode: const valid=v=>/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(String(v||'').trim()); const seen=new Set(); return $input.all().filter(item=>{const r=item.json||{}; const ok=String(r.workflow_version||'').trim()==='post_tour_sightings_v3' && String(r.approval_status||'').trim().toUpperCase()==='APPROVED' && !['SENDING','SENT','SKIPPED'].includes(String(r.delivery_status||'').trim().toUpperCase()) && valid(r.email) && r.email_html && r.email_subject && r.queue_id && !seen.has(r.queue_id); if(ok) seen.add(r.queue_id); return ok;});

const sent=$input.all(); const source=$items('Code • Restore Locked Email Payloads'); const now=new Date().toISOString(); return source.map((item,index)=>{const response=sent[index]?.json||{}; const failed=Boolean(response.error||response.message?.includes?.('error')); return {json:{...item.json,delivery_status:failed?'FAILED':'SENT',sent_at:failed?'':now,gmail_message_id:String(response.id||response.messageId||response.threadId||''),error:failed?String(response.error||response.message||'Gmail send failed'):'',updated_at:now}};});

parameters.content:
MBW Post-Tour Sightings Email — Approval Mode

1. Four times daily at :25 Ecuador time, look for completed birdwatching items and a guide report with the same tour date.
2. Create one email draft per guest and date. Ignore non-birding activities, missing emails, archived inquiries and incomplete tour items.
3. If reports from different guides exist on the same date, create nothing for that date instead of guessing.
4. Set approval_status to APPROVED to authorize sending.
5. The guarded sender runs at :30 every six hours and logs successful email IDs.

Safety: no email can send from a report or completed tour alone; manual approval is still required during the pilot.
